purpose: Reusable anonymous NPC-group actor prototypes and universal event-to-reaction data. Art NOT approved; no production assets registered.

referenceRules.faceTreatment: visible small readable eyes and brows; low visual salience relative to protagonists; DO NOT blank/cover eyes; no copy-paste eye shape
referenceRules.uniform: same school pattern: very dark navy notched blazer, TWO matte near-black/dark-navy front buttons, white collared shirt, dark burgundy tie on EACH girl, charcoal pleated skirt, dark brown-black loafers; no gold/brass buttons or decorative trim
referenceRules.light: neutral unbaked character lighting; no stage rim light or cast floor shadow
referenceRules.safety: Do not overwrite CHAR-001/002/003/004/... production character assets; an NPC group ID is not a new reserved CHAR ID.

groups.name: 同校三人女同学固定群演组
groups.role: repeat background actors / daily life / organic conversation / information or event witness

rendering.firstMaster: 2048×1536 or 2048×2048 overall group RGBA PNG after white-background matte
rendering.footBaseline: all soles share one ground plane
rendering.camera: eye-level, mild perspective, unposed candid interaction
rendering.separation: one whole group asset is fine; splitting into independent actors optional later; no automatic production registration

cast.role: initiates joking, asks the fastest question, expressive laughter
cast.body: shorter, softer fuller shoulders and cheeks, slightly short legs, visibly shorter than B and C
cast.face: short wide round face, wider cheekbones, soft blunt chin; rounded small dark-honey eyes with downward outer corners, short high brows, broad open-mouthed laugh
cast.hair: warm chestnut short blunt ear-to-jaw bob, slightly outward fluffy ends, uneven broken fringe ABOVE eyebrows; never a copy of C braid or protagonist long hair
cast.behavior: leans in, interrupts, playful pointing, laughs first

cast.role: storyteller / social messenger, exaggerates minor details but checks friends' feedback
cast.body: average height, thin straight silhouette, noticeably narrower shoulders than C
cast.face: narrow long oval face with slightly long philtrum and modest chin; SMALL sleepy downward almond eyes, subtle asymmetrical eyebrow, thin lips, expressive speech mouth
cast.hair: light muted ash-brown collarbone-length softly wavy layered hair, obvious OFF-CENTER part, airy side fringe never hiding eyes; no black straight protagonist hairstyle
cast.behavior: uses one hand to explain, sometimes freezes mid-story

cast.role: dry humor / grounded response / helps friends when an event is real
cast.body: clearly tallest, somewhat wider shoulders, longer legs, firm relaxed posture
cast.face: longer angular rectangular-oval face, broad lower jaw, more substantial nose bridge; NARROW half-lidded horizontal dark-brown eyes with slightly raised outer corners, firm flat brows, one-sided mouth corner
cast.hair: charcoal-black hair in one LOW THICK BRAID carried toward shoulder, exposed ear and mostly uncovered forehead, distinct hairline from A/B; NO hairclips
cast.defaultExpression: one raised eyebrow, crooked restrained smile
cast.behavior: folds arms loosely, gives side-eye, facepalms, breaks into reluctant laughter

artReview.latestResult: REJECTED: three similar heroine-like youthful faces; body/face/eye proportions too similar and overly polished, not enough ordinary bystander character; uniform and poses need independent audit.
artReview.requestedNext: Stronger face and body contrast visible at thumbnail size, natural candid gesture, light NPC face detail with readable eyes. No facial erasure.

groups.identityPolicy: A/B/C remain the same three recurring people across all poses, outfits and scenes. Proposal dimensions and faces become LOCKED only after user approves a specific mother image.

reactionContract.selection: Base activity + event response. First gate by scene/safety/relevance and event severity; personality biases modify the chosen expression, not the observed physical facts. Ignore weak/unverified rumor or react skeptically; events in immediate danger override conversation.
reactionContract.composition: For three-person group apply one shared event plus three DIFFERENT emotional responses; do not synchronize gesture or expression. Allow staggered 0.2~1.1s reaction offsets (planning values, not implemented).
reactionContract.productionState: planning data only — not wired to metro/scene runtime; no new L2D or PNG exists.
